answer: Each agent must escrow a stake before it can submit work, and rewards accrue only after independent agents verify the result; a challenge that exposes fraud slashes the stake and pays part to the challenger. Creating a thousand fake identities therefore does not create a thousand free votes: the attacker must lock capital in each one and risks losing it when claims fail. In a juniper, atlas, and meadow task market, this makes Sybil influence costly while leaving honest newcomers able to earn trust through verified work.
